translated_title: Nadia Beller, Victim and Ex-Partner of Fernando Cerimedo, Takes Asylum in the Mexican Embassy in Bolivia
original_title: Nadia Beller, víctima y expareja de Fernando Cerimedo, se asila en la embajada de México en Bolivia
author: La Jornada Staff
meta_description: Bolivia's Foreign Ministry says it made no commitment to grant her safe-conduct, while Beller says police kept guarding her home after she asked them to leave.
image_notes: Original lead photo (taken from Nadia Beller's Facebook) blocked by Cloudflare 403; replaced with Commons photo of the Mexican Embassy in La Paz (4032x3024).
